author_pitch: I've seen dozens of companies lose thousands of dollars in sales because their team lacks the time to analyze why users abandon their carts. title: Automate Your CRO: An AI Agent That Analyzes User Recordings for You
body:
Are you paying for session recording tools like Hotjar or Clarity but never have the time to watch the videos?

That is the ultimate bottleneck of modern CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization). Your online store or SaaS is losing customers at checkout or registration, and the answers are hidden in hundreds of hours of user recordings that your marketing team simply cannot review. You are accumulating terabytes of behavioral data, but you keep making design decisions based on intuition, leaving thousands of dollars on the table every month.

The trap of manual heat map analysis

Most SMEs install tracking scripts expecting a miracle, only to discover that finding the exact "rage click" or navigation error requires an exhausting forensic investigation. Data is useless if extracting the insights costs you more time than the problem itself.

Our solution: Integrated AI UX Analyst Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO we design and integrate a multimodal Artificial Intelligence Agent that connects directly to the API of your behavioral analytics tools. Using computer vision models and DOM event processing, the AI "watches" thousands of sessions in minutes, detects friction points, and delivers an executive report with the exact flaws in your interface.

  1. Massive Session Ingestion: We connect the Agent to Clarity, Hotjar, or PostHog to download and process metadata and frames from abandoned sessions.
  2. Friction Pattern Detection: The model identifies anomalies such as frustration clicks (rage clicks), erratic scrolling, or forms abandoned halfway through.
  3. Silent Error Classification: It detects JavaScript failures or mobile rendering issues that escape Google Analytics but block the purchase.
  4. Actionable CRO Reporting: It generates a prioritized list in your task manager (Jira, Trello, Asana) indicating exactly which button or text your development team needs to change.

The Real Impact on your E-commerce or SaaS

  • Hundreds of Hours Saved: Eliminate manual viewing work; the AI audits thousands of sessions while you sleep.
  • Increased Conversion Rate (CRO): Resolve real bottlenecks and interface frictions to convert more traffic into paying customers without increasing your Ads investment.
  • Data-Driven Decisions, Not Intuition: Go from guessing why users leave to having clear evidence and exact screenshots of the abandonment moment.
